This mission involves boarding ships. To board a ship, first you must disable it. Disabling a ship involves attacking it, but not to the point of destroying it. When a ship is disabled, its boarder becomes gray, as does its dot on the radar screen. It is important that you do not inflict massive damage to the ship when it has very low shields (<5%, except with big ships like Frigates or Cruisers), because you may destroy it accidentally. When a ship has very low shields or no shields, you should use your guns or turrets only to disable it. Larger weapons may destroy the ship.  After it is disabled, move to the ship and try to match its speed. Then, overlay your ship with the disabled one and align your hull to match its. Then, press "b" to board the ship. After a few tries, you should be able to board the ship. In this mission, you will be removing <CT> from the ship. When you have completed the mission, return the <CT> to Levo. Good luck.
